question: How has data packet size optimization in wireless sensor networks been modeled for network lifetime and energy efficiency, how have joint optimization with transmission power and assumptions about ACKs and retransmissions been handled, and in which environments (terrestrial, underwater, underground, body area, and smart grid) and with which methods (analytical models, MIP/LP, simulation, and experiments) has it been studied?

Paket boyutu ile iletim gücünün ortak optimizasyonu nasıl ele alınmış?
ACK ve yeniden iletim varsayımları nasıl ele alınmış?
Karasal, su altı, yer altı, vücut alanı ve akıllı şebeke ortamlarının her birinde hangi çalışmalar var?
